responsibility: Defines VAX-specific RTL patterns that supplement the main machine description with target builtins and specialized expansions that are easier to keep separate from the core instruction file. In this port it provides the RTL for count-trailing-zero and ffs expansion using the VAX FFS instruction, associated compare-elimination peepholes that model the unusual PSL condition-code effects, and atomic sync lock test-and-set/release sequences built from VAX bit-test-and-branch instructions, including the unspec codes used to keep those lock operations ordered in RTL.
